method: confirmed line bounds + IAST syllable priors + local positive spectral flux/RMS attack
limitations: No recognized phonemes or manually tapped syllables.
Vocal stem attacks can be pitch changes, consonants, separation artifacts or bleed.
Evenly spaced priors can misplace held syllables. Local adjustment is limited and all inferred times remain low confidence.

tathāpi vahati yan na mārṣṭuṃ śakyam
ācāryo nāgārjuno jñātavān — śūnyam idaṃ sarvam
kintu tālo na viramati — vayaṃ ca na
